metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1993 · Groundhog Day
metas.description: A narcissistic, self-centered weatherman finds himself in a time loop on Groundhog Day.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2023 · Barbie
metas.description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the outside world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among regular humans.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1975 · Monty Python and the Holy Grail
metas.description: King Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table embark on a surreal, low-budget search for the Holy Grail, encountering many, very silly obstacles.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2010 · Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A young man must defeat his new girlfriend's seven evil exes, who are willing to do anything to prevent her happiness with someone else.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1984 · Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1994 · The Mask
metas.description: Bank clerk Stanley Ipkiss is transformed into a manic superhero when he wears a mysterious mask.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2003 · Bruce Almighty
metas.description: A whiny news reporter is given the chance to step into God's shoes.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2011 · Midnight in Paris
metas.description: While on a trip to Paris with his fiancée's family, a nostalgic screenwriter finds himself mysteriously going back to the 1920s every day at midnight.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2013 · This Is the End
metas.description: Six Los Angeles celebrities are stuck in James Franco's house after a series of devastating events just destroyed the city. Inside, the group not only have to face the apocalypse, but themselves.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2013 · About Time
metas.description: At the age of 21, Tim discovers he can travel in time and change what happens and has happened in his own life. His decision to make his world a better place by getting a girlfriend turns out not to be as easy as you might think.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1988 · Beetlejuice
metas.description: The spirits of a deceased couple are harassed by an unbearable family that has moved into their home, and hire a malicious spirit to drive them out.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2006 · Click
metas.description: A workaholic architect finds a universal remote that allows him to fast-forward and rewind to different parts of his life. Complications arise when the remote starts to overrule his choices.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1999 · Being John Malkovich
metas.description: A puppeteer discovers a portal that leads literally into the head of movie star John Malkovich.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 1997 · Liar Liar
metas.description: A pathological liar-lawyer finds his career turned upside down when he inexplicably cannot physically lie for 24 whole hours.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2000 · How the Grinch Stole Christmas
metas.description: On the outskirts of Whoville lives a green, revenge-seeking Grinch who plans to ruin Christmas for all of the citizens of the town.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2012 · Dark Shadows
metas.description: An imprisoned vampire, Barnabas Collins, is set free and returns to his ancestral home, where his dysfunctional descendants are in need of his protection.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1988 · Big
metas.description: After wishing to be made big, a teenage boy wakes the next morning to find himself mysteriously in the body of an adult.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2016 · Ghostbusters
metas.description: Following a ghost invasion of Manhattan, paranormal enthusiasts Erin Gilbert and Abby Yates, nuclear engineer Jillian Holtzmann, and subway worker Patty Tolan band together to stop the otherworldly threat.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2004 · 13 Going on 30
metas.description: Unpopular schoolgirl Jenna Rink makes an unusual wish on her birthday. Miraculously, her wish comes true and the 13-year-old Jenna wakes up the next day as a 30-year-old woman.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2006 · Stranger Than Fiction
metas.description: I.R.S. auditor Harold Crick suddenly finds his mundane Chicago life to be the subject of narration only he can hear: narration that begins to affect his entire existence, from his work to his love life to his death.
